<!--
================================================================
  DIAGRAMA: Paradigmas de interoperabilidad + hitos HL7
  Quarto + revealjs (IFMER)

  Uso (usando el shortcode de include de Quarto):
  {\{< include paradigmas-hl7.qmd >}}
  o copiar y pegar dentro de slides.qmd.

  Iconos: trazos SVG propios, sin librerías ni marcas registradas.
  Espaciado horizontal conceptual (no a escala temporal).
================================================================
-->

```{=html}
<style>
.iop-viz{
  --iop-surface:#ffffff;
  --iop-surface-2:#f4f7fa;
  --iop-ink:#16202b;
  --iop-muted:#5b6b7c;
  --iop-line:#c7d2dd;
  --iop-steel:#6b5bd2;
  --iop-integ:#0b8a78;
  --iop-hl7:#d98324;
  --iop-hl7-soft:#fdf0dd;
  width:100%;
}
.iop-viz.dark{
  --iop-surface:#18212b; --iop-surface-2:#1e2833; --iop-ink:#e6edf4;
  --iop-muted:#9aabbc; --iop-line:#2e3c4a;
  --iop-steel:#9a8cf0; --iop-integ:#3fc7ae;
  --iop-hl7:#f0a94c; --iop-hl7-soft:#33260f;
}

/* --- controles --- */
.iop-viz .iop-bar{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.6em; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0 0 .4em}
.iop-viz .iop-switch{
  display:inline-flex; position:relative;
  background:var(--iop-surface); border:1px solid var(--iop-line);
  border-radius:999px; padding:4px;
}
.iop-viz .iop-switch button{
  font:inherit; font-size:.5em; font-weight:600;
  border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--iop-muted);
  padding:.45em 1.1em; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer;
  position:relative; z-index:2; transition:color .25s ease;
}
.iop-viz .iop-thumb{
  position:absolute; top:4px; bottom:4px; left:4px; border-radius:999px;
  background:var(--iop-surface-2); border:1px solid var(--iop-steel); z-index:1;
  transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.2,1), width .42s, border-color .42s;
}
.iop-viz[data-mode="hl7"] .iop-thumb{border-color:var(--iop-hl7)}
.iop-viz[data-mode="base"] .iop-switch button[data-mode="base"]{color:var(--iop-steel)}
.iop-viz[data-mode="hl7"]  .iop-switch button[data-mode="hl7"]{color:var(--iop-hl7)}
.iop-viz .iop-replay{
  font:inherit; font-size:.45em; color:var(--iop-muted);
  background:none; border:0; cursor:pointer; padding:.3em .2em;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--iop-line);
}
.iop-viz .iop-replay:hover{color:var(--iop-ink)}
.iop-viz button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--iop-steel); outline-offset:3px}

.iop-viz svg.iop-diagram{display:block; width:100%; height:auto}

/* --- tokens svg --- */
.iop-viz .n-name{fill:var(--iop-ink); font-size:16px; font-weight:700}
.iop-viz .n-sub{fill:var(--iop-muted); font-size:11.5px}
.iop-viz .n-year{fill:var(--iop-muted); font-family:ui-monospace,"IBM Plex Mono",monospace; font-size:10.5px}
.iop-viz .axis-lbl{fill:var(--iop-muted); font-size:12.5px; font-style:italic}
.iop-viz .band-lbl{fill:var(--iop-muted); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.04em}
.iop-viz .chip{fill:var(--iop-surface); stroke:var(--iop-line); stroke-width:1.5}
.iop-viz .gl{fill:none; stroke:var(--iop-steel); stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}
.iop-viz .gl-f{fill:var(--iop-steel); stroke:none}
.iop-viz .leader{stroke:var(--iop-line); stroke-width:1; stroke-dasharray:3 4; fill:none}
.iop-viz .divider{stroke:var(--iop-line); stroke-width:1}
.iop-viz .curve{fill:none; stroke:url(#iop-grad); stroke-width:5; stroke-linecap:round}
.iop-viz .arrowtip{fill:var(--iop-integ)}
.iop-viz .packet{fill:var(--iop-integ)}

.iop-viz .pin-body{fill:var(--iop-hl7); stroke:none}
.iop-viz .pin-year{fill:#fff; font-size:13px; font-weight:700}
.iop-viz .h-name{fill:var(--iop-ink); font-size:14px; font-weight:700}
.iop-viz .h-sub{fill:var(--iop-muted); font-size:11px}
.iop-viz .h-gl{fill:none; stroke:var(--iop-hl7); stroke-width:1.7; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}
.iop-viz .h-gl-f{fill:var(--iop-hl7); stroke:none}
.iop-viz .h-guide{stroke:var(--iop-hl7); stroke-width:1; stroke-dasharray:2 5; opacity:.55}

/* capa HL7 conmutable */
.iop-viz #iop-hl7-layer{transition:opacity .5s ease}
.iop-viz[data-mode="base"] #iop-hl7-layer{opacity:.12}

/* --- animación de entrada --- */
.iop-viz .curve{stroke-dasharray:1200; stroke-dashoffset:1200}
.iop-viz .anim{opacity:0; transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center}
.iop-viz.play .curve{animation:iop-draw 1.7s ease-out forwards}
.iop-viz.play .node{animation:iop-pop .55s cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.5,1) forwards; animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
.iop-viz.play .fadeup{animation:iop-up .5s ease-out forwards; animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
.iop-viz.play .drop{animation:iop-drop .6s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1) forwards; animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
@keyframes iop-draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@keyframes iop-pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.55)} to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes iop-up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(9px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes iop-drop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .iop-viz .curve{stroke-dashoffset:0 !important}
  .iop-viz .anim{opacity:1 !important; transform:none !important}
  .iop-viz *{animation:none !important; transition-duration:.01ms !important}
}
</style>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
  function placeThumb(viz){
    var mode = viz.getAttribute('data-mode');
    var btn = viz.querySelector('.iop-switch button[data-mode="' + mode + '"]');
    var thumb = viz.querySelector('.iop-thumb');
    if(!btn || !thumb || !btn.offsetWidth) return;
    thumb.style.width = btn.offsetWidth + 'px';
    thumb.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (btn.offsetLeft - 4) + 'px)';
  }

  function play(viz){
    viz.classList.remove('play');
    void viz.offsetWidth;              // reinicia las animaciones CSS
    viz.classList.add('play');
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var btn = e.target.closest('.iop-viz .iop-switch button');
    if (btn){
      var viz = btn.closest('.iop-viz');
      viz.setAttribute('data-mode', btn.dataset.mode);
      viz.querySelectorAll('.iop-switch button').forEach(function(b){
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.mode === btn.dataset.mode));
      });
      placeThumb(viz);
      return;
    }
    var rep = e.target.closest('.iop-viz [data-role="replay"]');
    if (rep) play(rep.closest('.iop-viz'));
  });

  function refresh(scope){
    (scope || document).querySelectorAll('.iop-viz').forEach(function(viz){
      placeThumb(viz);
      play(viz);
    });
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.iop-viz').forEach(placeThumb);
  });
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.iop-viz').forEach(placeThumb);
  });
  // reveal.js: animar al entrar a la diapositiva
  if (window.Reveal && Reveal.on) Reveal.on('slidechanged', function(ev){ refresh(ev.currentSlide); });
  setTimeout(function(){ refresh(); }, 350);
})();
</script>
```
